text:
Compliance Overview
Aperture Cloud maintains SOC 2 Type II certification, renewed annually. The certification audit covers
the ingestion pipeline, the retrieval service, and the generation service, but explicitly excludes
customer-managed on-premise deployments, which fall under the customer's own compliance scope.
Encryption Requirements
All customer documents are encrypted at rest using AES-256, and all API traffic is encrypted in transit
using TLS 1.2 or higher. Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days, matching the API token rotation
policy described in the API reference documentation.
Data Residency
Enterprise customers on the EU plan have their documents and embeddings stored exclusively in the
eu-west-1 region. Standard plan customers do not have data residency guarantees and may have
documents processed in either us-east-1 or eu-west-1 depending on load balancing at ingestion time.
Audit Logging
Every query and document upload is logged with a timestamp, the requesting API key, and the
resulting document or query ID, retained according to the query log retention policy for 180 days.
